card_title: How to Claim Your Business in ChatGPT
card_desc: Step by step: find your listing in ChatGPT Business Hub, verify it, and manage the details ChatGPT has about you.
meta_title: How to Claim Your Business in ChatGPT Business Hub (Free Guide) | Olivia Porter
meta_description: Step by step: claim your business in ChatGPT Business Hub, verify it, finish the identity check, and update your listing details.
sub: ChatGPT Business Hub lets you claim your business and manage the information you give ChatGPT about it. Here's how, step by step.
intro: Here's how to claim your business in ChatGPT.

before.label: Before you start
items: Make sure you can claim it.
You need to own the business or be authorized to represent it. Local stores and restaurants can currently claim only an existing U.S. listing.
For the identity check you may need a government-issued ID, business registration information, and proof that you're authorized to represent the business.

steps.title: Open Business Hub
steps.text: Sign in to ChatGPT and open Business Hub from the sidebar, or go to chatgpt.com/business-hub.

steps.title: Find your business
steps.text: Search for your business by name, pick the listing that matches, and confirm which ChatGPT account will manage it.

steps.title: Verify it
steps.text: Pick one way to prove it's yours:
list: Business email (the code goes to the email address associated with your business)
Website domain (you add a TXT record to your domain's DNS settings)

steps.title: Wait for the review
steps.text: OpenAI reviews your claim and emails you its decision, or asks for more information.

steps.title: Finish the identity check
steps.text: Next you verify your identity through Persona. You need this before you can publish changes to your listing.

steps.title: Update your details
steps.text: Once your claim and identity check are approved, update your website, business description, product or service category, and logo, plus delivery and return policies if they apply.

link.text: OpenAI's guide: Setting up your business on ChatGPT

closing: Claiming doesn't guarantee more visibility, and changes can take time to show up. What it does is put you in charge of the information you give ChatGPT about your business.
